description: AGSC-08-12: ci compiles a gate item's enforce[] value status-check, once per run, to dist/forge/status-checks.json, a JCS-canonical array of the check names the Bundle's gate items imply in code-point order, followed by one LF; of the four forge outputs only this one has pinned bytes. AGSC-08-09: a gate item's checks[] compile to one name per value, and a gate item with no checks[] implies its level's set (L1 schema and links; L2 adds provenance, determinism and review). Each sub-case runs `ci --json` over a scratch copy of the minimal fixture with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history. One L2 gate with no checks[]: the five names. Two gates, link-gate (L1, checks [schema, links]) and review-gate (L2, no checks[]): the union, each name once, the same five. A gate whose enforce[] does not name status-check: no such file (output null). Where the Bundle holds a file at the forge's own path that differs from the compiled one, here a .github/CODEOWNERS that names another owner beside a gate enforcing codeowner, ci reports AGSC-E707 for that file, exits 1 and leaves the file as it was (unchanged gives its bytes after the run). In every sub-case nothing is written under build.out by the compilation: no file whose path holds forge is under www/ (not_in_build_out). Running ci a second time gives the same bytes (idempotent).
